description: Start draft generation for an item and return its job ID. Accepted work consumes allowance. There is no dry run. With body.kit_mode=auto (default), workspace settings decide whether to hold a low-confidence kit. With hold_for_review, the kit pauses before writing at awaiting_review with kit_status=needs_review. This option requires the v2 article pipeline. A 409 article_pipeline_not_v2 or article_run_active rejects the request before any charge.

anyOf.description:
Whether the published article body shows source citations.

``STRUCTURED_ONLY`` (default) strips inline links to clean prose; the used
sources are still captured as metadata. ``INLINE`` keeps the links and
appends a ``## Sources`` section.
anyOf.title: CitationMode

anyOf.description:
How an article body shows its sources.

``bottom_only`` keeps prose free of links and appends a numbered sources
list; ``inline_only`` keeps inline links and appends no list.
anyOf.title: CitationStyle

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse for the same request after a dropped response; use a new key for a new intended operation.

name: generate_content_item

anyOf.description:
Accepted-generation envelope; poll the job for completion.

``status`` is typically ``running`` at kickoff, or ``queued`` when the run
is accepted but not yet assigned.

status.description:
Status of a background job.

Terminal states: ``completed``, ``completed_with_errors``, ``failed``,
``cancelled``. Active (in-progress) states: ``queued``, ``running``.

``awaiting_review`` is a third class: not terminal (work may resume after a
human action) and not active (no automatic progress is being made). Pollers
should treat it as stop-and-review rather than keep waiting for a terminal
status. It is intentionally in neither ``is_terminal`` nor ``is_active``.
status.title: JobStatus
